# Trademark Policy

The names "spoo.me" and "spoo" (in the context of link management), and the
spoo.me logo, identify the spoo.me project and its hosted service. They are
not covered by the code license.

The code is licensed under AGPL-3.0. You are free to use it, modify it,
self-host it, and fork it. That freedom applies to the code, not the name.

## You may, without asking

- Refer to the project truthfully: "built with spoo.me", "powered by the
  spoo.me API", "a fork of spoo.me"
- Keep existing attribution and copyright notices intact
- Use the name in articles, tutorials, talks, and package names of
  integrations (for example `something-spoo-client`)

## You may not, without written permission

- Name a fork, product, service, or domain "spoo" or anything confusingly
  similar
- Use the spoo.me logo as the mark of your own product or service
- Present your product or service as made, operated, or endorsed by spoo.me

If you run a modified public deployment, give it its own name and state that
it is based on spoo.me.

Questions or permission requests: support@spoo.me
